identityReview: Matched Signal president, AI Now cofounder and former Google organizer using Signal, AI Now, NYU, FTC and contemporary coverage. Birth date not established and omitted. US country label corroborated by Wikipedia search description.
lifeStatusEvidence: Masters of Scale published a video of her live debate with Neil Chilson on November 9, 2026, identifying her as Signal president. Read the episode description; did not watch or listen to the recording. November 9 is publication, not verified recording day.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Opened Signal appointment post and foundation biographies, AI Now current profile, NYU launch report, FTC appointment release, two organizer statements, Sky News departure report, official GPO hearing transcript, Masters of Scale video and episode pages, Burda announcement and Wikipedia.
sourceReview.scope: Current and historical roles, degree, collaborative research and worker organizing, testimony, appointment versus effective dates, and public debate release.
corrections: Signal announcement September 6, 2022 gives September 12 start. President works with CEO, so not identified as CEO or Signal founder. Foundation biography and current debate corroborate role.

AI Now current profile gives chief advisor and former faculty director. Kate Crawford cofounding retained; NYU November 20 report dates launch celebration November 15, 2017. Earlier initiative/symposia are not the same as institute launch.

FTC release identifies senior advisor on AI to the chair and Berkeley A.B. in rhetoric and English literature. Month precision November 2021 retained because readable release lacks visible date, though Wikipedia cites November 19. Former advisory role, not FTC chair or commissioner.

Primary farewell published July 16, 2019 says previous day was last workday. It reproduces her note about July 10 thirteenth anniversary, supporting 2006 start. Wikipedia infobox says Google 2006–2018, contradicting its own prose and primary record; not adopted.

Google retaliation allegations are disputed: Sky reports claims and company denial. Timeline reports departure and her stated continuing work, without asserting an adjudicated finding or proven causal retaliation.
Organizer release published November 2 dates walkout November 1, 2018 and names seven organizers. She is not sole organizer; headcount and individual misconduct claims omitted.
GPO hearing date and witness testimony confirm June 26, 2019. Her oversight and whistleblower proposals are recommendations, not enacted law or established universal AI behavior.
Burda uses day/month date 02/07/2025, meaning July 2. Board of Directors is strategic governance, not appointment as group CEO. No unsupported Nokia board role imported from a search aggregator.

Masters of Scale video date is November 9, 2026. Related episode and social snippets do not independently establish an exact recording date in the text inspected; timeline explicitly records publication. Debate positions are attributed, not universal technical conclusions.
OTF profile open returned 403; degree verified from full FTC release instead. No birth date, doctorate, exact graduation year, current NYU professorship or unrestricted security guarantee asserted.
